set.body: Extend the existing paragraph engine with bounded Unicode/grapheme-safe word wrapping, line-dependent bidi, line-bounded contextual reshaping and immutable measured/recorded line placement. Preserve source-global mappings and script context, explicit supplied-face fallback and missing text. Exact width selection must use actual candidate line shaping with shared budgets, not sliced glyph arrays or independent substring paragraphs. Report unbreakable overflow; do not invent trimming, hyphenation, emergency breaking or carets. Real font regressions, full JVM/Native and component checks, VISION/plans/evidence and Mote checkpoint required. Preserve concurrent kernel work and native-host gates.
set.title: G-0: Wrap paragraphs with exact line shaping and shared placement
